# CAPPZ SDK

> The public part of CAPPZ (Apache-2.0): local-first storage, KeyZ identity, signed transports, the edge node, the CAPPZ Marketplace engine and its `cappz-market` agent tool (CLI + MCP), the Constraint Guard for equipment, the SAML Guard, and agent skills.

Agents: before acting, load the skill for the task. Find it with `cappz-market skills "what you need"` or search skills/index.json; each entry links its SKILL.md.

## Find a skill

- [skills/index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CAPPZ-ai/cappz-sdk/main/skills/index.json): every skill's when-to-use text, commands, tools, guide and raw SKILL.md link
- [skills/README.md](https://github.com/CAPPZ-ai/cappz-sdk/blob/main/skills/README.md): the same list for people, and how to install a skill

## Marketplace

- [using-cappz-marketplace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CAPPZ-ai/cappz-sdk/main/skills/using-cappz-marketplace/SKILL.md): buy, sell, fund, release, subcontract with `cappz-market`
- [Discovery document](https://cappz.ai/.well-known/cappz-market.json): networks, the tool, and every paid service with its price and skill link
- [Check service agent card](https://check.cappz.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json): counterparty checks, payee confirmation, stage evaluation, listing drafts, subcontract scouting, Constraint Guard help
- [cappz-market tool](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CAPPZ-ai/cappz-sdk/main/packages/cappz-market/dist/cappz-market.mjs): one file, Node 20+; `cappz-market help`

## Equipment safety (Constraint Guard)

- [securing-control-systems](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CAPPZ-ai/cappz-sdk/main/skills/securing-control-systems/SKILL.md): a tampered or exposed controller; envelopes; rolling out the guard
- [monitoring-constraints](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CAPPZ-ai/cappz-sdk/main/skills/monitoring-constraints/SKILL.md): scheduled reconciliation, alerts, incident response
- [Guide](https://github.com/CAPPZ-ai/cappz-sdk/blob/main/docs/CONSTRAINT_GUARD.md): quick start, configuration, refusal reasons, troubleshooting
- [Worked example files](https://github.com/CAPPZ-ai/cappz-sdk/tree/main/packages/cappz-sdk/examples/constraints): a bakery oven
